description: This file defines the MultiBoxTracker class, which manages object tracking, non-max suppression, and recognition matching for object detection in an Android app, specifically within the TensorFlow demo environment. It wraps an ObjectTracker and handles visualization, detection results processing, and tracking lifecycle.

classes.name: MultiBoxTracker
classes.description: A class that tracks object detections, manages tracked objects, performs non-max suppression, and draws detection overlays for an Android app using TensorFlow.

methods.name: drawDebug
methods.description: Draws debugging information, including detection boxes and correlations, on the canvas.

methods.name: trackResults
methods.description: Processes detection recognition results from the detector, integrating them into the tracker.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the current tracked objects and their bounding boxes on the provided canvas.

methods.name: onFrame
methods.description: Processes a new frame, updates object tracking, and removes lost objects.

methods.name: processResults
methods.description: Converts detection results into tracked objects and updates the tracker.

methods.name: handleDetection
methods.description: Attempts to start tracking a new detection, managing overlaps and colors.
